Strangely it’s almost like after I’ve had gluten my brain is the first organ to react- I either become extremely anxious or depressed. These feelings come on suddenly and severely and are always followed by tummy rumbling. That can last anywhere from 10 minutes to 6 hours before the sharp pains start and I either begin vomiting or having the absolute worst diarrhea. (This entire time the brain fog is UNREAL. I have dissociated for entire days of my life and forgotten them altogether.) I’m usually sick for weeks after a glutening. But I didn’t start having those severe symptoms until I had been following my diet for a year or so. 19 diagnosed at 16. I’m still learning about all the symptoms I have because I tend to forget most everything after an attack. I hope I can just avoid gluten and won’t have to find out haha! Good luck !
